office_does: Hears and decides misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders in King County District Court for a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: District Court Judge Yvonne Chin, appointed by the King County Council in 2026, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: District Court judge appointed by the King County Council in 2026; previously a civil legal aid and public interest attorney, including at the Sexual Violence Law Center and the ACLU of Washington.
highlights: Appointed to King County District Court by the King County Council in 2026 [S1]
Former Legal Director of the Sexual Violence Law Center and Senior Staff Attorney at the ACLU of Washington [S1]
Former Judge and Magistrate Pro Tempore in Seattle Municipal Court [S1]
